# Nate Steinrueck

> UX Researcher who builds. Leads research for complex products, then designs, prototypes, and ships the solutions. Full-stack AI tools, production features, and everything in between.

Currently leading product research at IQVIA. Previously at Google (via Outer Labs), UnitedHealthcare (via RVO Health), and cove.tool. Based in Atlanta, GA.

50+ studies across healthcare, enterprise software, and design technology. Builds full-stack applications, AI agents, data pipelines, and production features.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://www.nathanielsteinrueck.com/): Overview of work, writing, and background
- [Medicare Trust Engine](https://www.nathanielsteinrueck.com/medicare-trust-engine.html): Doubled digital enrollments at UnitedHealthcare through trust barrier research and personalized routing redesign
- [Google Planning Tool](https://www.nathanielsteinrueck.com/google-planning-tool.html): Led research for AI-powered generative space planning tools at Google
- [UX Research Copilot](https://www.nathanielsteinrueck.com/ux-research-copilot.html): Multi-agent AI system for research synthesis (Python, FastAPI, React, GPT-4, FAISS)
- [AEC Hub](https://www.nathanielsteinrueck.com/aec-hub.html): Intelligence platform for architecture and construction industry (Next.js, Supabase)
- [Reno AI](https://www.nathanielsteinrueck.com/reno-ai.html): iOS app with computer vision for home redesign (Swift, CoreML, ARKit)

## Blog

- [AI-Augmented UX Research](https://www.nathanielsteinrueck.com/blog/ai-augmented-ux-research.html): Turning research findings from one-time deliverables into living knowledge systems using AI-powered insights bots and custom research copilots
- [Evals Are the New Design Critique](https://www.nathanielsteinrueck.com/blog/evals-design-critique.html): Building resilient AI systems through evaluation-driven development, connecting Andrew Ng's agentic AI patterns to design critique practices
